title: Impact snapshot + raise primer (Q4–Q1)
content:
Purpose: quick, scannable evidence pack and rehearsal notes for manager 1:1.

Context (short):
- Role: Senior People Ops Partner (IC) — scoped to Eng org (platform + infra).
- Timeline: contributions span 2025 Q4 through 2026 Q1 (last 6 months).
- Ask in mind: leveling/comp review (informal first touch) — framing: impact, scope increase, and proposed comp range.

Top-line impact bullets (one-liners to open the conversation):
- Reduced new-hire onboarding time by ~22% (12 -> 9 days median) via onboarding checklist automation + cross-team playbook (see metrics below).
- Enabled two org restructures with minimal ramp friction by designing role templates and ramp checkpoints; org-level efficiency: ~1.5 fewer escalations/week during transition windows.
- Negotiated and closed three high-priority contractor conversions into full-time by building flexible offer cadence and manager decision templates; retained 100% of key hires.
- Built cost-light development program for frontline managers (8 sessions), uptake 60% of eligible managers, Net Promoter ~+24.

Concrete evidence (bullet, metric, source):
- Onboarding time: median time-to-productivity KPI tracked in HR-sheet: 12 days (2025-10) -> 9 days (2026-01); source: HR onboarding dashboard (confluence link above).
- Onboarding playbook adoption: 78% of new eng managers used the checklist in their first 2 weeks (internal survey n=41).
- Restructure support: number of post-reorg escalations (Platform infra): 11 -> 4 (first 6 weeks post-change); logs in #eng-reorg and support ticket JIRA-OPS-712.
- Conversion hiring: closed 3/3 conversions with time-to-offer reduced from avg 18 days -> 9 days; saving estimated ~12k in recruiting spend.
- Manager program feedback: 8 sessions, 24 managers attended, average session rating 4.5/5, follow-up manager action adoption tracked in spreadsheet (linked).

Examples to cite (short narratives):
- Case: platform team restructure (Nov 2025): I owned the role template set, manager checklist, and two-week ramp checkpoints. Result: fewer layer-1 PM/escalations and smoother backlog transition. Specifics: coordinated with Platform Eng lead (S. Tanaka), weekly touchpoints, and a 5-point ramp checklist we iterated twice.
- Candidate conversion (Dec 2025): identified offer blockers, supplied data-backed comp rationale, redesigned offer timeline; manager and candidate accepted in 6 days.

Skills demonstrated (framing for manager):
- Cross-functional influence: got buy-in from Eng leads, Recruiting, Legal, and Finance for faster conversion flows.
- Program design + data: built simple KPI dashboard (Google Sheet) to track onboarding velocity and program adoption.
- Ops at scale: created templates and runbooks that are now reused across two squads.

Development notes / gaps (honest):
- Need to scale delegation: spent too many cycles on coordination; want to promote a deputy/process owner model.
- Data maturity: current dashboards are manual; next step is a lightweight automated export from ATS.
- Leadership exposure: want to own a cross-org initiative (e.g., talent-planning Q3) to show strategic scope.

Suggested ask and framing (how I plan to open):
- Opening: "I wanted to share a short snapshot of what I've moved in the last six months and explore whether my scope and impact align with a level/comp adjustment."
- Proposed scope change: move to IC4 responsibilities (lead cross-org programs + partner with Sr. Eng leaders on headcount planning).
- Proposed comp band: ask manager for guidance but propose a target range of 120–135k base (market comp + internal parity).
- Non-comp asks: clear development path (sponsor for talent planning project), delegated owner to run day-to-day onboarding ops.

Negotiation prep (fallbacks & priorities):
1) Preferred: comp + clear career milestone to hit (e.g., lead headcount planning).
2) If immediate comp uplift not possible: time-boxed development project + mid-point comp review in 6 months.
3) If neither: request scope and title change with commensurate expectations and documented progression plan.

Manager 1:1 agenda (30 min):
- 5 min: signal — quick update on two current blockers.
- 10 min: impact snapshot (use the one-liners + 1 example).
- 10 min: propose ask + hear manager perspective.
- 5 min: next steps / proposed timeline.

Quick rehearsal snippets (what to say):
- "I wanted to get your perspective on whether my contributions and scope map to the next band. I have concrete examples and some proposal options."
- "If we agree scope aligns, what timeline and checkpoints would you be comfortable with for a formal comp review?"

Open questions I want answered in the meeting:
- What are the blocker inputs for compensation decisions this quarter (budget, conversion targets, bench)?
- Who else needs to be in the conversation for a comp uplift (People lead, Finance)?
- What concrete milestone would be required to make this a 6-month vs 12-month timeline?

Action items post-meeting (draft):
- Send a short follow-up note (email) summarizing agreed next steps within 24h.
- Pull supporting artifacts: onboarding KPI sheet, conversion details, manager program feedback.
- Draft a short one-pager to share with People lead if manager requests.

Notes-to-self (scratch):
- Keep tone collaborative, not transactional. Emphasize impact and future scope.
- Bring printout of 2 graphs (onboarding velocity + conversion time) in 1:1.
- If manager pushes budget, propose the 6-month time-boxed project as trade.
- Practice the top-line 30s pitch twice.

Misc: links to artifacts I need to attach when requested:
- onboarding KPI sheet (sheet id: OPS-ONB-2026, link above)
- conversion case notes (JIRA-OPS-712)
- manager program slides (internal deck in drive, tag: manager-program-Q4)

End of scratch — rough, editable. Will trim to single-page one-pager if manager asks.
